methods.name: LowerBound
methods.signature: method LowerBound(a: seq<int>, x: int) returns (p: int)
methods.header:
method LowerBound(a: seq<int>, x: int) returns (p: int)
  requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i <= j < |a| ==> a[i] <= a[j]
  ensures 0 <= p <= |a|
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < p ==> a[i] < x
  ensures forall i :: p <= i < |a| ==> x <= a[i]

methods.name: Locate
methods.signature: method Locate(a: seq<int>, x: int) returns (found: bool, index: int)
methods.header:
method Locate(a: seq<int>, x: int) returns (found: bool, index: int)
  requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i <= j < |a| ==> a[i] <= a[j]
  ensures found <==> (exists i :: 0 <= i < |a| && a[i] == x)
  ensures !found ==> index == -1
  ensures found ==> 0 <= index < |a| && a[index] == x
  ensures found ==> (forall i :: 0 <= i < index ==> a[i] != x)

mutants.violation: LowerBound always returns length regardless of insertion point; Locate independently reports every query found and returns that unchecked index.

development_limitations.shortcut: Contracts require results, not binary search or even the LowerBound call; the reference uses a modular call and linear scan. Sortedness is a meaningful precondition of that call.
development_limitations.seed_violation: LowerBound always returns length regardless of insertion point; Locate independently reports every query found and returns that unchecked index.

representations.natural: [R1] LowerBound accepts a sequence sorted in nondecreasing order. [R2] LowerBound returns p between zero and the sequence length inclusive. [R3] Every element at an index before p is strictly less than x. [R4] Every element at an index at least p is at least x. [R5] Locate accepts a sequence sorted in nondecreasing order. [R6] Locate returns found exactly when x occurs in the sequence. [R7] When x is absent, Locate returns index minus one. [R8] When found is true, index is in bounds and its element equals x. [R9] When found is true, no earlier index contains x, so index is the first occurrence.
